All — quick tax take: 

- Because the supplier is a Spanish-registered entity and the invoice will be issued to Redwood Ireland (EU-to-EU B2B), the correct treatment is reverse-charge (no Spanish VAT charged) if the invoice lists Redwood IE VAT ID and the transaction is a standard intra-EU service/goods move. We need the supplier to state the reverse-charge reference on the invoice (e.g., "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive").

- No fiscal representative should be required for Spain in this flow provided the supplier is invoicing from Spain to an EU VAT-registered buyer (Redwood IE). Fiscal reps are typically needed when a non-established supplier wants to register; not our case.

- Action for procurement: confirm the invoice sample includes buyer VAT (Redwood IE) and the reverse-charge wording. AP should validate mapping so VAT is not withheld.

Karthik — flag if local PO fields need to capture buyer VAT for EMEA entity mapping.

Thanks,
